en.title: Qantas to take Airbus A321XLR international from Brisbane to Manila
en.summary: Qantas is preparing to take its Airbus A321XLR fleet international for the first time, with Brisbane-Manila services switching from the Airbus A330-200 to the A321XLR on February 1, 2027, allowing the route to operate daily with 197 seats.
body: Australian flag carrier Qantas is preparing to take its Airbus A321XLR fleet international for the first time, with flights between Brisbane Airport (BNE) and Manila Ninoy Aquino International Airport (MNL). The airline originally planned to introduce the aircraft on October 25, 2026, but has since postponed the launch until February 1, 2027. The aircraft will replace the much larger Airbus A330-200 currently operating the route. The two cities are separated by about 3,596 miles (5,787 km), and the scheduled flight takes around eight hours each way.

The A321XLR was specifically developed to make longer routes commercially viable with fewer passengers. It will offer 197 seats, allowing Qantas to operate the route daily rather than flying a larger widebody only a few times per week, giving passengers greater flexibility, particularly those traveling for business or connecting to onward services. The frequency increase was postponed only until November 23, meaning the A330 will temporarily operate the expanded daily schedule. According to Qantas' official A321XLR specifications, the aircraft can travel up to 5,406 miles (8,700 km), more than 1,864 miles (3,000 km) further than the Boeing 737 it is replacing. Qantas has previously identified other potential international markets, including Melbourne to Phuket and Sydney to Phnom Penh, where demand might not be high enough to sustain widebody operations.

The change is not without disadvantages. When the route was relaunched in 2024, Brisbane Airport highlighted that the A330 could provide up to 15 tonnes of export cargo capacity on each outbound departure, and replacing the widebody with a smaller narrowbody aircraft will inevitably reduce the space available for carrying cargo. Passengers will also lose lie-flat business class seats: the Airbus A330-200 offers lie-flat seats in a 1-2-1 configuration, with 26 to 28 business class seats converting into fully flat beds of approximately 79 inches (201 cm), while the A321XLRs initially scheduled for the route have 20 recliner-style business class seats in a 2-2 layout, with 37 inches (94 cm) of pitch and five inches (12.7 cm) of recline, and no individual IFE screens. Qantas has now ordered 48 A321XLRs, 16 of which will feature lie-flat business class seats and individual IFE screens from 2028, as part of its wider Project Winton fleet renewal program, which also includes the Airbus A220 and is intended to progressively replace its aging Boeing 737 and Boeing 717 fleets.

zh.title: 澳航A321XLR將首度飛國際線，布里斯本—馬尼拉2027年2月上線
zh.summary: 澳洲航空將首度以空中巴士A321XLR執飛國際線，布里斯本—馬尼拉航線預定2027年2月1日改由A321XLR執飛，取代A330-200；A321XLR僅197個座位，讓澳航得以每日飛航。
body: 澳洲航空準備首度以空中巴士A321XLR執飛國際線，布里斯本—馬尼拉航線原定2026年10月25日導入，現延至2027年2月1日，A321XLR將取代目前執飛該航線的A330-200。布里斯本與馬尼拉相距約3596英里（5787公里），單程飛行時間約8小時；該航線2024年10月28日復航，初期每週4班，2025年10月增至每週5班。
A321XLR僅197個座位，遠少於A330，讓澳航得以每日飛航，提升商務旅客與轉機彈性；每日班次自11月23日起先由A330暫代執飛，2027年2月1日起由A321XLR接手。A321XLR航程可達5406英里（8700公里），較其取代的波音737多出逾1864英里（3000公里），澳航也曾點名墨爾本—普吉、雪梨—金邊等需求不足以支撐廣體客機的市場作為潛在航點。

代價是貨運與客艙體驗縮水：A330每班出境可載最多15噸出口貨物，改用窄體客機後貨運空間必然縮減；商務艙也由A330的1-2-1平躺座椅（26至28席，床長約79英寸）改為20個2-2斜躺座椅，椅距37英寸、後仰幅度5英寸，且無個人娛樂螢幕。澳航共訂購48架A321XLR，其中16架將自2028年起採平躺商務艙與個人娛樂螢幕配置；A321XLR機隊屬Project Winton機隊更新計畫一環，另含A220，逐步取代老舊波音737與717機隊。
